verdict.rationale: Checkout.com has a documented manage-disputes section and a dedicated disputes-testing environment. Its webhooks report "progress on disputes," which supports tracking the dispute lifecycle. Nothing in the pack shows how a finance-ops user submits structured evidence to answer a chargeback, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented evidence-submission flow (API or Dashboard) with structured evidence fields, explicit dispute status/lifecycle states through to resolution, finance-ops Dashboard workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
